build_maskrcnn_c4_predictor: build a MaskRCNNC4Predictor module with transposed conv and 1x1 conv layers for mask prediction
build_maskrcnn_conv1x1_predictor: build a MaskRCNNConv1x1Predictor module with a single 1x1 conv layer for mask prediction
create_roi_mask_predictor: create an ROI mask predictor from config using make_roi_mask_predictor factory function
review_maskrcnn_c4_predictor_forward: review the MaskRCNNC4Predictor forward pass that applies transposed conv, ReLU, then 1x1 conv
review_maskrcnn_conv1x1_predictor_forwar: review the MaskRCNNConv1x1Predictor forward pass that applies a single 1x1 conv for mask logits
